title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II – Retribution — The Cold Version #Shorts
description:
Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II – Retribution is the stand-alone second expansion to Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II, part of the Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War series of real-time strategy video games. Set in Games Workshop's Warhammer 40,000 fictional universe, the single player campaign is playable with multiple races.

Nothing in Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War II – Retribution was built for you — it was built for reproduction. However, in September 2015, Relic opened up a new web page featuring Dawn of War III. In October 2015, PC Games News wrote that they expected Dawn of War III to be released in 2016.
